name: 17005-longdecode-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B -- ungated, ~16 GB of bf16 weights on one card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 120 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, over `/v1/chat/completions`. Prompt 1024 tokens and generation 1024 tokens, both fixed (stdev 0), with `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, `logprobs: true` and `top_logprobs: 4` -- all four declared in scenario.json under `spec.backend.extras.body`, because guidellm sends none of them by default. Responses are streamed. Seed 17005.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant streaming long 1024-token replies with token probabilities to 8 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# host/port/served-model-name are owned by the serving layer, not by this file.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
